insert into {0} (ReportSessionId, empId, dep1, dep2, dep3, dep4) WITH RECURSIVE search_tree AS ( SELECT r.id, r.parent, 1 AS level, ARRAY[r.id] AS path, ARRAY[r.id] AS deps, r.isheadquarters_overrid_dirrx FROM public.sungero_core_recipient r WHERE r.discriminator = '{1}'
UNION ALL
SELECT r.id, r.parent, st.level + 1, path || r.id, case when st.isheadquarters_overrid_dirrx != true then array_prepend(r.id, deps) else deps end, r.isheadquarters_overrid_dirrx FROM public.sungero_core_recipient r JOIN search_tree st ON r.id = st.parent WHERE r.discriminator = '{1}' )
SELECT '{2}' as ReportSessionId, employee.id, dep1.name, dep2.name, dep3.name, dep4.name FROM ( SELECT s.id, s.level, s.path, s.deps, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY path[1] ORDER BY level DESC) AS rn FROM search_tree as s ) AS st JOIN public.sungero_core_recipient AS employee ON employee.department_company_sungero = st.path[1] LEFT JOIN sungero_core_recipient as dep1 on dep1.id = st.deps[1] LEFT JOIN sungero_core_recipient as dep2 on dep2.id = st.deps[2] LEFT JOIN sungero_core_recipient as dep3 on dep3.id = st.deps[3] LEFT JOIN sungero_core_recipient as dep4 on dep4.id = st.deps[4] WHERE employee.discriminator = '{3}' AND st.rn = 1 AND employee.businunitdirrx_esspls_dirrx = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY('{4}', ';')::bigint[]) AND ('{5}' = '' or employee.department_company_sungero = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY('{5}', ';')::bigint[]));

with report_table as ( select distinct employee.persnumber_company_sungero as persnumber, employee."name" as employeeName, jobTitle."name" as jobTitleName, comp.name as company, deph.dep1 as firstDepartment, deph.dep2 as secondDepartment, deph.dep3 as thirdDepartment, deph.dep4 as fourthDepartment, case when employee.consenthrpro_hrproso_hrpro = @Signed then case when doc.intapprstate_docflow_sungero = @SignedState then @Acquainted when doc.intapprstate_docflow_sungero = @PendingSignState and doc.acquiantanceop_overrid_dirrx = @ElectronicAcqOption then @NotAcquainted else @OutsideConsent end else @OutsideConsent end as statusAcq, case when employee.consenthrpro_hrproso_hrpro = @Signed then case when doc.intapprstate_docflow_sungero = @SignedState then doc.approvaldatedi_overrid_dirrx::text when doc.intapprstate_docflow_sungero = @PendingSignState and doc.acquiantanceop_overrid_dirrx = @ElectronicAcqOption then '' else @OutsideConsent end else @OutsideConsent end as dateAcq, case when employee.consenthrpro_hrproso_hrpro = @Signed then @HasConsent else @NoConsent end as statusConsent from dirrx_nnvacat_vacationsinfor as information left join sungero_core_recipient as employee on employee.id = information.employee left join sungero_content_edoc as doc on employee.id = doc.employeedirrx_overrid_dirrx and doc.discriminator::text = @DocTypeGuid and doc.documentkind_docflow_sungero = @DocKindId left join sungero_company_jobTitle as jobTitle on jobTitle.id = employee.jobtitle_company_sungero right join dirrx_reports_dephierarchy as deph on deph.empid = employee.id left join sungero_core_recipient as comp on comp.id = employee.businunitdirrx_esspls_dirrx where extract(year from information.year)::text = @DateAcq or extract(year from doc.year1_vacatio_hrpro)::text = @DateAcq and deph.reportsessionid = @ReportSessionId -- Проверка прав доступа к документу order by employeeName )
select persnumber, employeeName, jobTitleName, firstDepartment, secondDepartment, thirdDepartment, fourthDepartment, statusAcq, dateAcq, company, statusConsent from report_table where (@StatusAcq = '' or statusAcq = @StatusAcq)
